the combination of trypsin-processed Cry4Aa with trypsin- or S. frugiperda GJ-processed Cry11A resulted in the highest levels of toxicity to all insect cells.
the Cry toxins are toxic to insect cells, but not to mammalian cells, and that Cyt2Ba is toxic to human cells.
